title: Q3 Expansion Plan - Market Entry Strategy
content: Q3 expansion targets two new regions: DACH and Southeast Asia. DACH entry is planned for month 1 via a local reseller partnership. Southeast Asia entry is planned for month 2 via a direct sales hire in Singapore.

title: Q3 Expansion Plan - Headcount & Budget
content: Q3 expansion headcount: 4 new sales hires and 2 new solutions engineers, budgeted at $860,000 fully loaded for the quarter. Budget owner: Finance.

title: Q3 Expansion Plan - Timeline & Milestones
content: Milestone 1 (Week 2): reseller contract signed for DACH. Milestone 2 (Week 6): Singapore hire onboarded. Milestone 3 (Week 10): first DACH customer live.

title: Current Runway & Burn Rate Report
content: Current cash runway is 14 months at the present burn rate of $410,000 per month, including the Q3 expansion budget of $860,000 spread across the quarter.

title: Sales Pipeline Overview
content: Sales pipeline for Q3 stands at $2.1M in qualified opportunities, with DACH and Southeast Asia expansion expected to add two new regional pipelines by month 2.
